consequence.statement: Informational: this only adds new optional fields for configuring pod DNS via the template sections; the evidence states nothing is removed, rejected or changed for existing configurations, so an operator who does nothing is unaffected.
consequence.remediation: None required; operators may optionally adopt the new dnsPolicy/dnsConfig template fields where DNS behaviour needs tuning.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 added support to configure the pod `dnsPolicy` and `dnsConfig` through the `template` sections of its custom resources (e.g. spec.kafka.template.pod.dnsPolicy and spec.kafka.template.pod.dnsConfig in the Kafka CRD, with matching paths under the cruiseControl, entityOperator, jmxTrans and kafkaExporter template pod sections).
